schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.short_description: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year payable in three equal instalments to landholding farmer families across India.
schemes.benefit_summary: ₹6,000 / year cash benefit directly to bank account
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

schemes.name: Namo Shree Yojana (Gujarat State)
schemes.short_description: Nutritional and financial assistance for pregnant and lactating mothers across Gujarat.
schemes.department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Gujarat

schemes.name: Kisan Suryoday Yojana
schemes.short_description: Provides day-time solar power supply to Gujarat farmers for agricultural irrigation.
schemes.benefit_summary: Subsidized solar power for daytime farm irrigation

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Amrutam (MA / MA Vatsalya) Yojana
schemes.short_description: Cashless medical treatment cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per annum per family for BPL and low-income families in Gujarat.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Gujarat
schemes.short_description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
schemes.benefit_summary: Health assurance cover up to ₹5 Lakh/year

schemes.name: Gujarat NFSA Subsidized Ration Distribution
schemes.short_description: Subsidized wheat, rice, sugar, and fortified salt for AAY and PHH ration card holders across Gujarat.
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly subsidized food grains & essential commodities
schemes.department: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Gujarat

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
schemes.short_description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca house to all houseless households living in rural areas.
schemes.benefit_summary: Financial aid of ₹1,20,000 for house construction

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban - Gujarat)
schemes.short_description: Interest subsidy and financial assistance for urban affordable housing.
schemes.benefit_summary: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh on home loan
schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

schemes.name: Shramik Annapurna Yojana
schemes.short_description: Nutritious full meal to registered construction workers for just ₹5 per meal at Kadia Nakas in Gujarat.
schemes.benefit_summary: Subsidized hot meal at ₹5/meal for registered workers
schemes.department: Labour, Skill Development and Employment, Gujarat

schemes.name: Kunwarbai nu Mameru Yojana
schemes.short_description: Financial assistance to SC/ST/SEBC girls at the time of marriage.
schemes.benefit_summary: Financial aid of ₹12,000 for bride's marriage

schemes.name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana
schemes.short_description: Free bicycles provided to SC/SEBC female students studying in Class 9 in Gujarat.
schemes.benefit_summary: Free bicycle for Class 9 girl students

schemes.name: Palak Mata Pita Yojana
schemes.short_description: Monthly financial support for foster care of orphan children up to 18 years of age.
schemes.benefit_summary: ₹3,000 / month financial foster support per child

schemes.name: SC Micro Business Interest Subsidy Yojana
schemes.short_description: Interest subsidy on bank loans for self-employment and micro businesses for Scheduled Caste individuals.
schemes.benefit_summary: Interest subsidy up to 4% per annum on business loans

schemes.name: Manav Garima / Cottage Tool Kit Scheme
schemes.short_description: Free tool kits provided to traditional artisans, tailors, cobblers, and micro-workers for self-reliance.
schemes.benefit_summary: Free professional tool kit for micro trade

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.short_description: Monthly pension for senior citizens above 60 years belonging to BPL families.

schemes.name: Sant Surdas Disability Pension Scheme
schemes.short_description: Monthly financial pension assistance for severely disabled individuals (80%+ disability) in Gujarat.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
schemes.short_description: Scholarship awarded to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropout in Class 8.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Gaumata Poshan Yojana
schemes.short_description: Financial subsidy to Gaushalas and Panjrapoles in Gujarat for cattle feeding and maintenance.
schemes.benefit_summary: Financial maintenance subsidy for cattle shelters
